name: Murai Mariko
source: Another transfer student like Souichiro, except she is not an otaku. Only attends the school because her uncle, the principal, is making her. As the only non-otaku in school, she is always annoyed by the strangeness going on around her. Refuses to wear the maid style school uniform.
translation: Another transfer student like Souichiro, except she is not an otaku. Only attends the school because her uncle, the principal, is making her. As the only non-otaku in school, she is always annoyed by the strangeness going on around her. Refuses to wear the maid style school uniform.
